description: This Java class defines MqttContext, a data structure used during MQTT message processing within the Eclipse Hono project. It encapsulates message details, device info, topic parsing, and metrics handling.

classes.name: MqttContext
classes.description: A context object for MQTT message processing, encapsulating message details, device info, topic parsing, and metrics.

methods.name: fromPublishPacket
methods.description: Creates a new MqttContext from a published MQTT message and device endpoint, optionally with an authenticated device.

methods.name: fromConnectPacket
methods.description: Creates a new MqttContext for a connection attempt based on the endpoint.

methods.name: message
methods.description: Returns the MQTT message to process.

methods.name: deviceEndpoint
methods.description: Returns the MQTT endpoint over which the message was received.

methods.name: authenticatedDevice
methods.description: Returns the authenticated device identity, if available.

methods.name: contentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the message payload.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the content type of the message payload.

methods.name: tenant
methods.description: Returns the tenant ID associated with the device or topic.

methods.name: propertyBag
methods.description: Returns the property bag extracted from the topic, if any.

methods.name: endpoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint type derived from the topic.

methods.name: isAtLeastOnce
methods.description: Checks if the message QoS level is at least once (QoS 1).

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Sends a PUBACK to acknowledge message receipt.

methods.name: setTimer
methods.description: Sets a timer object for measuring processing duration.

methods.name: getTimer
methods.description: Retrieves the timer object used for processing duration measurement.
